apps/android/app/src/main/java/com/futo/.why: the keyboard toolbar's items, labelled from ToolbarSpec (generated from packages/editor/src/toolbar.ts); each is an editor verb
the message field's call site; the field itself is labelled feedback.placeholder inside MessageField
the move sheet's destination rows, labelled by their paths: PickFolder
a folder card and a note card, labelled by their names: OpenFolder and OpenNote, by folder= and note=
result cards, labelled by their notes' titles: OpenNote
the language row and its menu items, labelled by language names (SetLanguage), and a segmented button inside its component, labelled by its caller's options (Segmented: SetTheme)
the app icon row, labelled with the chosen icon's name (OpenAppIcons), and the picker's onSelect, its tiles labelled with each icon's name (SelectAppIcon)
the confirm button, labelled by the catalog key its caller passes (Delete, Delete everything, Open existing), which ConfirmDialog claims
the plate's action buttons, filled and text, each labelled from its action (catalogPath): BuyLicense, StartLicenseEntry, OpenLostKeyHelp, RemoveLicense
the three unlock-method rows (the row and its selectable), each labelled from its method (sync.hosted.unlock.doors.*): SelectUnlockMethod
the menu's key and direction rows, each labelled from NoteSortPreference: SetSortOrder

noControl.android:OpenNote: a note card, labelled by the note's title; futo-puppet pairs it by the row's note=
noControl.android:SetSortOrder: a row of the open sort menu, labelled from NoteSortPreference (counted under computed)
noControl.android:OpenNoteContextMenu: a long press on a note card, labelled by the note's title
noControl.android:OpenFolderContextMenu: a long press on a folder card, labelled with its name
noControl.android:CloseContextMenu: a tap outside the open row menu
noControl.android:DismissDialog: the move sheet's swipe down or a tap on its scrim, the sheet having no Cancel button; and the license ask's Not now, a button labelled through its helper
noControl.android:SetSearchQuery: the search field, whose placeholder is a Text drawn beside it rather than the field's label
noControl.android:SetFindQuery: the find bar's query, a classic EditText inside an AndroidView that the source scan does not read (the listener reads it at runtime, PuppetHostedField)
noControl.android:SetLanguage: a language row, labelled by the language's own name
noControl.android:RemoveFeedbackAttachment: each screenshot's remove button, labelled with its number (feedback.removeScreenshot takes it)
noControl.android:OpenFolder: a folder card, labelled with its name (folders.rowAccessibilityLabel takes it); futo-puppet pairs it by the row's folder=
noControl.android:BuyLicense: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.android:StartLicenseEntry: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.android:OpenLostKeyHelp: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.android:RemoveLicense: one of the license plate's action buttons, labelled from its action (counted under computed)
noControl.android:SpinCoin: a tap on the supporter coin, a 3D view with no label
noControl.android:ConfirmDialog: ConfirmDialog.kt's ConfirmDialog claims the key its caller passes (Delete, Delete everything, Open existing), which this check, reading only quoted keys, cannot see
noControl.android:ScanPairingCode: the camera reading a pairing code; the verb takes the string it would have read
noControl.android:ShowPairingCode: the show-a-code button, labelled for the state (a code, or a new one) by ShowCodeButton's caller
noControl.android:SelectUnlockMethod: the three unlock-method rows are labelled from the method's name, so no one key names them
noControl.android:SetRecoveryKeySaved: the recovery-key checkbox, whose label is the Text beside it rather than its own
noControl.android:SelectAppIcon: an icon tile, labelled with the icon's name
noControl.android:OpenAppIcons: the app icon row, labelled with the chosen icon's name

unclaimed.android:notes.actions.share: hands the note to the OS share sheet; the app does nothing more
unclaimed.android:settings.about.openSource: opens the project's page in the browser: the OS's act
unclaimed.android:sync.serverSetupLink: opens the server setup guide in the browser: the OS's act
unclaimed.android:editor.android.legacyWebView.upd: opens the System WebView's store listing: the OS's act
unclaimed.android:feedback.removeScreenshot: RemoveFeedbackAttachment, whose label takes the screenshot's number
unclaimed.android:folders.rowAccessibilityLabel: OpenFolder, whose label takes the folder's name
